title: The Quiet Town
summary: At the Pine Hollow ranger cabin, Nora and her niece Ava hear the nearby town go silent over the radio.

beats.text: Day one. First the birds went quiet. Every bird on the lake, at once.
Ava, my niece, was busy complaining that the cabin has no signal.
At nine, the ranger radio started talking. Too many voices. All at once.
Cedar Falls asking for backup. Then for ambulances. Then nobody asked for anything.
One message got through before the signal died: Stay with Nora. Don't come to the city.
Her mom is my sister, a nurse in Port Ellis. Ava read it ten times.
Around midnight, something walked out of the trees by the dock.
It moved like a man who forgot how his legs worked.
I killed the fire. Ava grabbed my arm.
It stopped at our window. And it was wearing a ranger's uniform.
